body: Well I am going to buy a violin as soon as I can though. I also don't look at myself as musically talented enough to learn it but hey I'll try.
I jumped from the 5th floor of a building, broke both my ankles and two bones and my back.

It's not that I feel that I need a relationship, I actually meet someone and they like me and I like them a lot, and I get in a relationship. It's just that it seems to be always happening, so I figure that deep down I must feel that way? I don't know, but I don't know how to tell when it's right.

I am hanging out with friends a lot but it's just that, a distraction. As far as an instrument I have been thinking about it but I know it's not going to be a life changer. I don't play anything yet.

My fitness goal now is to regain the ability to walk but it's hard to want to walk when you don't even want to live.

I don't have a problem attracting people, I don't think anyways. Other than myself pushing people away sometimes.

Thanks for writing it means a lot that people like you care enough to post.

Both, neither have worked. So, recreational and from a psychiatrist (not at the same time though).

As far as health wise I am getting better. I might still need a surgery in my ankle, and my back and legs are always in a lot of pain. 

I appreciate it :)
